venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — CC Atlanta is closed on Sundays; no EON report is expected. Dark day, not an outstanding report.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — MOD KE, Chef JMS. Not a particularly busy day but a good one nonetheless. Small crowd for the tail end of the World Cup, slower after that until a handful of guests came through around 11:30pm. JM, head of Food & Bev for the Hermitage Hotel, came in with the Hermitage head chef — they had a drink, talked shop, and did a shot with Ian and Graham (Optimist, Sunday regulars). Ian is heading to New Orleans later this month to represent TN in a seafood cook-off. Last guests were first-timers. Favorite moment: two guests wanted food right after the kitchen closed — Joe went to Charmers to try to score them a burger and offered to pick up an appetizer from Optimist; they declined but were overwhelmed by the hospitality. Comps $37.70 / 2.49%. Low tonic. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — AM MOD Maggie H., PM MOD Carey. AM/DC sales $1,497.17; D&C (PM) $9,620.87; Garden/6A $2,138.60. Awesome busy morning — yoga-and-paint was a hit, everyone grabbed a cocktail for the garden. Evening was smooth and steady with a stark drop-off at 9pm instead of the usual evening pop; early cuts made. Garden was a quiet lil Sunday — dates and family get-togethers; very high UV index scared away most potential guests. Chill kitchen night with Dante, Nate, and Isaias. Comps $284.82 / 2.56%. 209 guests (Tock). Fro Spro machine needs looking at before next week's service. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Team getting stronger every day.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — MOD Thomas. Overall doldrums — never had more than the bar and the front of the room full. Connected with DC lawyers, a Texan six-top, and a couple whose Zed's Dead Forest Hills show was washed out by a biblical flood. 71 covers, 1 large party (11:30 arrival), 2 solos, 0 investor cocktails. Top sellers: High Plains Drifter, Chips & Dip, Rosalie/Paper Wasp (tie). Door notes: the World Cup is over — hopefully back to normal business. Very slow night through and through; given current staffing/kitchen situation it may have been for the best (kitchen in snack mode). Welcomed industry friends; Dante impressed. Street quiet after 11pm. 5 cancellations, no no-shows. Retail $26. Comps $55.80. 1 egg coupe broken; Max fixed a ton of chipped glasses.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — MOD Joe + Oscar + Saleh. Another successful Sunday! Started the evening with 40 covers; the Arts District was sleepy early but the bar top filled almost immediately and the room slowly followed. Used the first hour for deep cleaning in the kitchen and walk-in. Sad day in the kitchen — Ruffy's last prep shift, and he knocked it out of the park as usual. Member Carlos Martinez stopped by with a large group enjoying off-menu drinks. After 8pm the room stayed completely full until last call; lots of familiar faces excited not to be at Tales. Very smooth last call with good vibes. Standing Room $0. Comps $233 (Zak Rager, Ray Mitchell, Edwin's friends, Francisco, birthdays, anniversaries, investors, DNL). 126 guests; report lists check average $101.31 (per-check basis; net/guest = $40.20). 86 rockfish, 86 pot de crème. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: a regular dropped off pastry. (Note: Typeform date field mis-typed as 2030-07-19; matched by post time.)

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — MOD Marcus. Marquee bar sales $1,711.96 gross; Garden $0; net including events $1,556.33. Despite nicer weather, a brutally slow start — the bar top saw some love but the dining room didn't seat its first guests until after 7pm. Adjusted labor accordingly: called Savannah off on the low reservation count and cut Jordan at 7pm. The room never fully filled, so downtime went to ABK and team development. Last call just after 9:30pm. Lots of first dates! Guests: 45 total (4 reso / 39 walk-in... plus bar). Kitchen snack-only. Cash payments today — unable to add cash tips in shift review on bar 1000 and bar 2000. Maintenance: curtains; service drain needs attention. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: Table 32 living the ghost machine.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday, July 19, 2026** — AM MOD Sam/Justin + Lex/Shannon; PM MOD Braden/Marcus. Municipal Bar morning $2,431; evening $2,520; Sun Club $341; Hot Eye $994. Morning: slow and steady, cut to two servers by noon, then a solid pop at 1:30 with a tour and half the dining room filling — quiet again by 2:30. Evening: very slow until 9:30, then everyone came at once — bar filled for a full turn and the restaurant got about half full within 30-40 minutes, from families at full dinner to hotel guests winding down. No SA or barback put close behind. Hot Eye: slow with a smaller bar crawl at 9, dead time used for a bar scrub, then a solid industry crowd from 11 to last call. Kitchen painfully slow; worked the Monday cleaning list; one count branzino, three count mousse. Guests 93 (OpenTable morning; evening count not logged). Comps $265. Maintenance: pump acting up again; maintenance sign on all lobby restrooms (Mezz available); guests in 306 escorted to their room after falling off a stool (no report filed). Favorite: Vamo España — a great service-industry ending in THE!
